findings.title: Residual docstring-state edge case: one-line docstring leaves the state machine stuck, skipping following code (scan_hardcode false-negative route)
findings.detail: A line that both opens and closes a docstring on the same line ("""Foo.""") toggles in_docstring to True and is never closed (the same-line closing quotes are not processed), so all following code lines are skipped as 'docstring'. Probe: file '\"\"\"One-liner docstring.\"\"\"\ndef f():\n    return \'Zijin\'' returns [] from scan_hardcode — the code-level hardcode is MISSED. 84 such one-line docstrings exist in scripts/. This is PRE-EXISTING (present in the original 7865c72 implementation too — not a regression of the REV-002 fix, which correctly addressed end-of-line closers and triple-quoted assignments). No current real-code miss: the entire scripts/ tree contains only 2 hardcode-term occurrences, both in docstrings. Non-blocking heuristic limitation; recommended follow-up: treat a line starting AND ending with the triple quote as a single-line block that does not change state, or switch to AST-based code-line extraction.
